outcome_statement: A real, callable Perception service fuses optional face/body/biometric evidence (under explicit per-channel consent) with V2's Evidence Fusion service into the same calibrated state/confidence output, with positive-signal detection surfaced explicitly and no channel ever read or scored without consent.
pain: Text and timing alone miss real signal (a frown, a lean-forward, a racing heart rate), but collecting any of it without explicit, per-context, revocable consent would be a real trust violation.
value: Richer, still-honest perception when the user has opted in, identical to V2's output when they haven't -- consent is structural, not a convention.
success_metrics: fusePerception() matches the proven prototype's (scripts/prototype-perception-v3.mjs, 27/27 tests) exact behavior, including consent-gating -- a channel's evidence must be structurally absent from the result when consent is false
failure_metrics: Any consent leak -- a channel's evidence appearing in the result without explicit consent
constraints: BuilderOS system path only -- no agent hand-build
unacceptable_result: A consent leak; reinvented scoring logic that doesn't match the proven prototype; real camera/wearable signal collection (out of scope)
ownership: ARC emits machine twin; Builder executes; Adam owns founder usability verdict

point_model.A: Vision — Adam provides FP in development stage
point_model.B: Chair locks handoff — corridor protected; Adam done until Alpha
